metadata.name: Fernwood Moon
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A redwood forest on a forest moon at dusk. The Rebels hold a treetop village: plank platforms ringing six giant trunks, sagging rope bridges, rope lifts, climbing vines and a lookout 24 m up. The Garrison hold a shield bunker in a clearing, with a landing pad and a 30 m dish antenna. Upload the stolen code at the forest outpost to open the bunker blast door, or take the long way over the roof and down the maintenance hatch. Hover bikes race the winding trails between the trunks, past swinging logs and rockfalls. Bomb: blow the generator hall (A) or the antenna (B).

do.text: Fernwood Moon. The bunker door answers only to the outpost code.

rules.name: The stolen code opens the blast door

do.text: Code accepted: the bunker blast door is open!

rules.name: The Garrison seals the blast door
Rocks come down on the west trail
